scope: Four corrective acceptance surfaces: Home Events asset identity, Home Recommend media identity/rail, Home New Arrival reversible control state, and the separate held-out Demo page boundary.

eventsAssetIdentity.scope: Home Events six linked rows at the observed 390px viewport

requiredByItem.identity: Extra Grand Battle official pickup thumbnail
BANDAI CARD GAMES Fest 26-27 official pickup thumbnail (Jakarta)
BANDAI CARD GAMES Fest 26-27 official pickup thumbnail (Manila; source-shared)
Flame-Flame Fruit Tournament official pickup thumbnail

eventsAssetIdentity.sharingPolicy: Only items 4 Jakarta and 5 Manila may share an identity, because the official source DOM shares that exact URL and SHA-256. Every other pair must differ.
forbidden: generated image or SVG for any source event item
any shared identity except items 4 and 5

acceptance.passWhen: six item positions match requiredByItem; unique SHA count is exactly 5; the sole duplicate group is [4,5]; generatedAssetCount is 0

recommendDistinctMediaRail.scope: Home Recommend five-item wanted-poster rail at the observed 390px viewport
organization: five semantic linked poster cards in source order
each item retains its own Evidence-matched 640x360 image
forbidden: one image reused across multiple cards
item count used instead of rail structure

acceptance.passWhen: five displayed media SHA-256 values are pairwise distinct and positionally equal to requiredByItemSha256; every intrinsic dimension is 640x360; cover crop and clipped rail organization are present

newArrivalReversibleControls.scope: Home New Arrival previous/next buttons and rail wrapper at 390px
newArrivalReversibleControls.afterPrevious: Restores the complete initial state, including active 1 / 10, translateX approximately 0, and previous disabled semantics.
newArrivalReversibleControls.semantics: Buttons must execute a real reversible state transition. Visual-only arrows, no-op handlers, direct screenshot swapping and fake enabled/disabled styling are forbidden.

acceptance.passWhen: all active identity, transform, ARIA, tabindex, pointer-events and opacity assertions pass in both directions

required: a distinct Demo page/route is directly navigable
the route consumes the frozen generative recipes named by goal-contract.json
forbidden: inserting the held-out section into source-mapped Home
claiming held-out as official Home evidence
setting mapsToSourcePageId to home or another source page
using a hidden/unreachable fragment as the page

acceptance.passWhen: route resolves independently; route/page registry mapsToSourcePageId is null; Home contains no held-out organism; direct navigation and separate capture succeed
